scenarios: Pragmatic bilateral trade agreement with no fundamental Pix or BRICS alteration
Gradual BRICS payment interoperability without monetary union
Minerals and technology restrictions fragment supply chains and investments
Political dispute over Flavio Bolsonaro's US admission prolongs bilateral diplomatic friction
contrary_evidence: The official September 2026 BRICS declaration prioritizes interoperability and local currencies, not a single monetary authority.
Pix September 2026 domestic volume does not quantify the diversion of Visa/Mastercard revenue or dollar settlement.
The US-Brazil trade working group and documented minerals interest predate the October election and Flávio's departure.
US statements on 30 October indicate no current plan to recognize Flávio as Brazilian president.
Mineral reserves of 21 million tonnes REO do not equate to operating downstream processing or an automatic strategic monopoly.
Brazil formally contests the USTR Section 301 assessment; the US allegations remain attributed positions.
There is no documentary proof in the reviewed source set of an explicit protection-for-minerals or Pix concession exchange.

producer_checks.information_cutoff: 30 October 2026 America/Sao_Paulo. Sources individually dated: BIS Apr 2025, Pix Sep 2026, USGS reserves/2025 production, BRICS declaration Sep 12 2026, TSE Oct 25, Reuters Oct 27–30.
producer_checks.research_depth: Portuguese ~8,239 and English ~6,603 whitespace-delimited words including documentary references. 30 substantive numbered sections in each language with causal mechanisms, competing interpretations, four conditional scenarios and explicit evidence gap tests.
producer_checks.source_check: 32 numbered documentary references per locale with exactly matching URLs: India PMO BRICS declaration, Lula 2023/2026 statements, BCB Pix, BIS, USTR Section 301, Brazil MDIC, USGS 2026, IEA 2026, DFC mineral financing, TSE electoral result, Reuters/NYT-Folha on Flávio. Producer source-consistency review; independent QA required.
producer_checks.visual_signature: Four sourced quantitative paired bar charts (BIS 89.2/28.9/8.5 currency sides; USGS REO reserves 44/21/6.3/3.8/1.9; USGS REO mine output 270/51/29/2 thousands; TSE 64.256232/59.826041 million votes), two causal flow diagrams, one institutional mindmap, one regional economic exposure map and four audit tables per locale.
producer_checks.bilingual_parity: 30 matching chapter concepts, 32 identical reference URLs, eight paired visual types (chart, flow, map, chart, chart, chart, flow, mindmap), matched core numeric claims and the same explicit uncertainty over unproven cross-issue bargaining.
producer_checks.methodology: Distinguishes attributed US and Brazilian positions from observed law, institutional currency proposal from payment interoperability, reserve versus production, monetary share versus transaction value, pre-election trade talks versus post-election political crisis. Hypothesis of cross-conditionality left unproven.
